updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The US stock market attempted to break to a new high this week, with the S&P 500 ETF (SPY) showing a technical setup for further gains, but low volume and a lack of conviction in buying indicate a less favorable risk-reward ratio.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: The release of the PCE data came as expected, with headline PCE at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%, while personal spending dropped 0.1% below consensus, highlighting a consumer pullback.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: The market reaction was muted, with the S&P 500 ETF (SPY) showing a relatively flat performance, while oil prices rose to a 3-month high due to seasonal demand and supply disruptions.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor should consider waiting for the air to clear post the presidential debate, as the uncertainty may impact various sectors, and focus on established mega-cap stocks and fossil fuel energy stocks.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week, investors should watch for the market's reaction to the presidential debate's outcome, as well as the potential impact on the US economy and international standing.
